LanguageData.HP_Setup: Choose how to initialize this world's free cities. Keeping the existing world changes no ownership. Configuring initial cities moves the reviewed NPC settlements into one REAL Free City Union faction with shared diplomacy, standard union trade/defenders and ideology. Player faction, visited towns, loaded maps, charter records and each source faction's last base are excluded. Player membership, council votes, automatic wars and conquest are not connected yet. This is world setup, not negotiated NPC independence. Gameplay validation is deferred. Closing this window defers the choice.
LanguageData.HP_Keep: Keep existing world; form contracts during play
LanguageData.HP_Ratio: Initial free-city target: {0}% of eligible towns (maximum 10, at most one from each source faction).
LanguageData.HP_Plan: Reviewed selection: {0} cities. No ownership changes until confirmed.
LanguageData.HP_Apply: Confirm initial cities and apply REAL faction changes
LanguageData.HP_Done: Initial configuration has been applied. No additional automatic conversion will occur.
LanguageData.HP_Configured: Initial Free City Union configuration recorded. Review the city list for the applied results.
LanguageData.HP_Rejected: Political setup could not be completed. Check changed ownership, existing maps/contracts and pending records. Completed changes are retained; do not assume every selected city moved.
LanguageData.HP_Recover: Recheck pending admission without moving the city again
LanguageData.HT_Enable: Enable real tribute for this charter
LanguageData.HT_OptIn: Optional experimental physical payments: enabling starts a new schedule now, with no retroactive bills. Manual delivery removes real caravan goods. Protection missions, faction membership changes and collection visits are not implemented.
LanguageData.HT_Account: Real tribute enabled. Only manual subject delivery is supported; no goods are taken automatically. Existing debts remain payable after mutual release.
LanguageData.HT_Bill: Period {0}: principal value {1}, delivery value {2}, due in {3} days (negative means past due).
LanguageData.HT_Overdue: Overdue. This does not automatically assign dishonor or start a war.

LanguageData.HT_NoCaravan: Bring a player caravan onto a settlement tile owned by the charter's liege faction, then select payment again.
LanguageData.HT_RealWarning: REAL DELIVERY — confirming transfers the selected inventory into the NPC settlement's trade stock. Prices use the game's current sell-price rules. Excess value is not refunded or applied to other bills. Only ordinary inventory items are supported. This code has not been tested in gameplay.
LanguageData.HT_Deliver: Confirm delivery of these real goods
LanguageData.HT_Delivered: Physical tribute delivered and receipt recorded.
LanguageData.HT_Recover: Recover pending delivery or return verified goods
LanguageData.HT_Recovery: Recovery attempted. Unproven transfers remain reserved; retained escrow is not discarded. The bill is not reopened until the full return is verified.
LanguageData.HT_Unavailable: Payment unavailable or quote changed. Check ledger status, current ownership, caravan location, negotiator, goods and quoted value. Favor-based or title-restricted trading is not supported yet. An interrupted transfer remains reserved for recovery.
LanguageData.HCL_Warning: DEVELOPMENT CHARTER RECORDS — real settlement references with separate NPC/player consent. Physical tribute requires explicit opt-in and manual delivery below. Player shared diplomacy and eligible NPC membership each require separate review and confirmation. Automatic protection is not implemented. Native player control is preserved. The fictional model is separate. Gameplay validation is deferred.
LanguageData.HCL_Unavailable: Charter action unavailable: check the current owner, representative, diplomacy, pending offers and existing bonds.
LanguageData.HCL_NpcAgreed: The NPC representative accepted the proposed record. Review the terms and confirm your own consent separately.
LanguageData.HCL_NpcDeclined: The NPC representative declined. This initial negotiation policy requires at least {0} goodwill for this role.
LanguageData.HCL_ReleaseRefused: The NPC representative declined release; the charter remains active. This initial policy requires 20 goodwill.
LanguageData.HCL_Terms: Recorded terms: fixed tribute value 100 every 5 days, 1-day grace; subject delivery with a 10% transport allowance. Optional manual physical tribute starts only after enabling it. Protection requires timely troop support, but its enforcement is pending. NPC acceptance currently requires 0 goodwill to become your liege, or 50 to become your vassal; honor/performance negotiation is pending.

LanguageData.HCL_OfferProtection: Offer protection as liege of this settlement
LanguageData.HCL_Empty: No charter records. Select an NPC world settlement to request terms.

LanguageData.PA_Warning: DEVELOPMENT PREVIEW — Confirming membership changes REAL external goodwill and war/peace relations for ALL player settlements to match the selected authority, including future changes. Relations with the authority start at +100 (ally). Your colony and pawns remain player-controlled. Review the relations below before confirming. Union exit requires 3 days' notice, resolved physical transfers and a signed new liege contract; there is no unilateral exit button yet. Union levies, council votes and automatic protection are not implemented. Gameplay validation is deferred.
LanguageData.PA_Suspended: Shared diplomacy suspended. The authority, contract, quest relation lock or player goodwill cap no longer permits sharing. Existing relations are retained. Resolve the conflict, then request reaffirmation; ownership and contract records are preserved.
LanguageData.PA_Reaffirm: Request reaffirmation after resolving the conflict
LanguageData.PA_ReviewLiege: Review diplomacy of the signed liege contract
LanguageData.PA_Notice: Give 3 days' notice of union departure
LanguageData.PA_NoticeUntil: Notice remaining (days; zero or less means elapsed): {0}. A signed new liege contract and settlement of pending transfers are still required.
LanguageData.PA_Review: Selected authority: {0}. Visible external factions are listed below. If the source relations change, review again before confirming.
LanguageData.PA_Join: Confirm union admission and apply shared diplomacy
LanguageData.PA_ApplyLiege: Confirm signed liege allegiance and apply shared diplomacy
LanguageData.PA_RelationsChanged: Shared diplomacy changed the relationship with: {0}. The game has been paused for review.
LanguageData.PA_Rejected: Political change unavailable. Review current relations, authority consent, released prior ties, notice and pending transfers. Quest locks or player goodwill caps may prevent sharing.
LanguageData.CT_Warning: DEVELOPMENT PREVIEW — Confirming changes this NPC town's REAL faction, shared diplomacy, future inhabitants, trade and faction ideology/technology. Player bases and pawns remain under player control. Visited towns can move only while unloaded, with no saved inhabitants and verifiably unchanged ordinary trade goods. Stock containing people, animals, corpses or containers is excluded. Existing goods are neither regenerated nor confiscated; future trade and restocking follow the destination faction. Hostility and pending delivery block movement. Real source factions keep another base; only your verified administration may become empty. Released towns need an existing union and no newer active contract. Signing/releasing remains separate from movement. Gameplay validation is deferred.
LanguageData.CT_Active: Apply the mutually signed charter: the NPC town joins the player's current shared political authority while remaining an NPC town.
LanguageData.CT_Released: Apply the mutually released charter: the NPC town joins the existing Free City Union. Old contracts and execution history are preserved. This is not a unilateral independence ruling.
LanguageData.CT_Recover: Check interrupted change: confirm destination or cancel if unmoved
LanguageData.CT_Unavailable: Territory change unavailable. Check signed/released status, unresolved proposals, player shared authority or existing union, current ownership, source's remaining bases, unloaded map, saved inhabitants, ordinary stock and pending deliveries. Changed stock requires a fresh review; changed stock during a pending move blocks recovery. A town already at the destination needs no move. Resolve interrupted moves first.
LanguageData.CT_Applied: Faction change applied; actual ownership verified
LanguageData.AD_Warning: Optional NPC administration for your vassal towns. Establishing it adds a REAL faction with an internal +100 alliance; external diplomacy follows the player, and external goodwill events involving its towns affect player diplomacy. Your own bases and pawns remain player-controlled. This preview uses industrial outlander troops, trade and ideology, rather than preserving player/local culture. Quest or permanent relation conflicts suspend mirroring. Random raids, military aid and quest sites are disabled; compatibility with every other quest/mod is untested.
LanguageData.AD_Suspended: Administration diplomacy suspended. Resolve internal hostility, player allegiance suspension or quest/permanent relation conflicts, then resume. Existing towns and ownership records are preserved.
LanguageData.AD_Unavailable: Administration unavailable. A live player colony and valid unique administration are required. Establish it while unaffiliated. A defeated/duplicate faction cannot be replaced; goodwill caps, locked relations or suspended player allegiance may block sharing.
LanguageData.FB_Open: Align vassal towns with current polity
LanguageData.FB_Warning: Review ALL active NPC city vassals against your current administration/union/liege. New allegiance changes include this follower review. All moves are checked first, including cumulative source losses and existing ordinary stock. Real sources retain another base; only your administration may become empty. Visited towns may move with preserved ordinary goods, but loaded maps, saved inhabitants, people/animals or nested stock block movement. A town already at the destination needs no move. Transfers execute one at a time. If interrupted, completed moves remain; recover the pending city against its saved stock evidence, then review the remaining group. Gameplay validation is deferred.
LanguageData.FB_Complete: Vassal alignment completed: {0} faction changes verified.
LanguageData.FB_Incomplete: Vassal alignment is incomplete or the reviewed state changed. Completed changes are retained. Resolve pending ownership, recheck player allegiance/diplomacy and review the whole group again.
LanguageData.PS_Warning: Membership and ALL active NPC city vassals are now reviewed together. Confirmation applies real player diplomacy, then moves the reviewed cities with per-city ownership proof. A staged intent is saved; partial progress is retained rather than rolled back or called complete. Nothing resumes automatically after loading. If interrupted, check any pending city, review the remaining diplomacy/towns, then resume. Only preparation with unchanged player allegiance and city journal can be cancelled. Other contract changes and new physical deliveries wait until resolution. Existing unpaid debts remain owed.
LanguageData.PS_Confirm: Confirm diplomacy and reviewed vassal moves together
LanguageData.PS_ReturnUnion: Review union return after mutual contract release
LanguageData.PS_Complete: Political transition complete: recorded allegiance, shared diplomacy and all reviewed vassal destinations confirmed.
LanguageData.PS_Pending: A coordinated political transition needs resolution. Recover pending city ownership and review/resume here, or cancel unchanged preparation before allegiance is applied. Other political/contract changes and new physical deliveries are paused.
LanguageData.PS_Prepared: Intent prepared; check actual allegiance before cancellation or recovery.
LanguageData.PS_AllegianceApplied: Allegiance recorded; diplomacy or remaining city execution still needs confirmation.
LanguageData.PS_Cancelled: Unchanged transition preparation cancelled; no allegiance or city movement was reversed.
LanguageData.PS_ReviewResume: Review current destination and remaining towns
LanguageData.PS_Resume: Reaffirm reviewed diplomacy and resume remaining moves
LanguageData.PS_DebtsRetained: Old contracts, unpaid bills and receipts remain in their ledgers. Union return or a new liege does not forgive debt. Union levies and unilateral independence are not implemented.
LanguageData.PS_Rejected: Political review unavailable. Check actual mutual release/new contract, union notice, live destination consent, quest/goodwill limits, pending goods/city transfers, unloaded towns without saved inhabitants, preserved ordinary stock and cumulative source bases. A future hostile relationship with a follower's source blocks this preview's peaceful move. An existing union is required for return.
LanguageData.PS_Incomplete: Political transition is incomplete or the review changed. Verified stages and cities are retained. Check pending ownership, then review/resume here. If allegiance never changed and the city journal is unchanged, cancel preparation instead. No automatic rollback or restart was performed.
LanguageData.CA_Open: Inspect this town's residents and stock
LanguageData.CA_OpenAll: Choose a vassal town to inspect
LanguageData.CA_Note: READ-ONLY INSPECTION. No ownership, pawn status, inventory, contract or saved journal is changed. This report does not approve a move or recover an interrupted one. Saved residents remain unsupported: the native pawn faction API also resets guest status, surgery bills, medical settings and mental/job state. Stock is read without generating or restocking it. Counts refer to saved references or stock entries, not stack units. Flags may overlap. Inspect again after changes; actual transfer review still applies all contract, destination, diplomacy and resource checks. Gameplay validation is deferred.

LanguageData.CA_MapUnloaded: No map is currently loaded. This alone does not authorize migration.
